title: Equivariant tensor lift over a fixed normalized ordinary closed structure
statement: Fix k0, l, X, NativeClosedHomModels M and a natural Hom comparison eta satisfying NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility as in [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. Assume X separated and finite type over the finite field k0, and l prime different from its characteristic. Fix an ordinary CoefficientClosedStructure S on M.ordinaryHom, a symmetry beta, an equality of S.monoidal with the canonical derived module monoidal structure, and NativeOrdinaryTensorModels for S and beta relative to M.ordinaryRepresentatives. There exist a native CoefficientClosedStructure W on M.weilHom, a symmetry gamma, a native coefficient-unit isomorphism delta, an ordinary coefficient-unit isomorphism epsilon, a tensor comparison tau for nativeForget, and TensorCoherence c of [lem-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition]. Its unit is exactly nativeForget.mapIso(delta), then mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor at the native coefficient module, then epsilon inverse. For every derived arrow f:A → M.weilHom(K,L), ordinary uncurrying of nativeForget(f) followed by eta(K,L) equals tau(A,K) inverse followed by nativeForget of the native uncurry of f. The canonical ordinary monoidal structure and its adjunction normalization are inputs; both coefficient-unit identifications are outputs, and no biduality claim is made.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison, naturality of evaluation, and transposition paragraph; native refinement of lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful. Equivariant lift and normalized forgetting in transport steps 1--2.

proof.text: Construct T, adjunctions a_K, their counit naturality, and an invertible tau whose inverse on (A,K) is ordinary uncurrying of F(unit(a_K)_A) followed by eta.

Obtain m with m.tensor=T, symmetry, coefficient-unit identifications and tensor coherence for the very same tau. Substitute the equality of tensor functors. The identity-component isomorphism tensorSliceIso identifies the restricted bifunctor T(-,K) with Mathlib tensorRight K. Transport a_K along it; its unit and counit components are unchanged. Assemble CoefficientClosedStructure W from m, these adjunctions and the given counit naturality.

For f:A -> M.weilHom(K,L), put g=uncurry_W(f). The adjunction identity gives unit(a_K)_A followed by M.weilHom(1,g)=f. Naturality of eta at (1_K,g) moves F(g) through eta. Naturality of ordinary inverse transposition then gives uncurry_S(F(f) followed by eta)=tau.inv(A,K) followed by F(g). This is proved by uncurry_of_tensor_unit; no representative calculation on arbitrary f is left.

proof_origin.place: H3 reduction: tensor adjoints and invertible unit mate; monoidal coherence; formal derivation of all-arrow uncurrying from adjunction units and naturality (2026-10-27).

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_tensor_lift
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (η : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (_hη : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) η)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom)
    (β : @SymmetricCategory _ _ S.monoidal)
    (_hmonoidal : S.monoidal = (inferInstance : MonoidalCategory
      (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber))))
    (_hS : NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
      M.ordinaryHom M.ordinaryRepresentatives S β) :
    ∃ W : CoefficientClosedStructure M.weilHom,
    ∃ γ : @SymmetricCategory _ _ W.monoidal,
    ∃ δ : W.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (adicConstant k₀ l X),
    ∃ ε : S.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (ProEtale.AdicSheaf.unit l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber),
    ∃ τ : W.tensor ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
        (nativeForget k₀ l X).prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ S.tensor,
    ∃ c : RingedForgetTensorTransposition.TensorCoherence
        W.monoidal S.monoidal γ β (nativeForget k₀ l X) τ,
      c.unit =
        ((nativeForget k₀ l X).mapIso δ ≪≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
            (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) 0).app
              (adicConstant k₀ l X) ≪≫ ε.symm) ∧
      ∀ (A K L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X))
        (f : A ⟶ M.weilHom.obj (op K, L)),
        (S.transpose ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj A) ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K)
            ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj L)).symm
              ((nativeForget k₀ l X).map f ≫ (η.app (op K, L)).hom) =
          (τ.app (A, K)).inv ≫
            (nativeForget k₀ l X).map ((W.transpose A K L).symm f)
